slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single blob at EEPROM blocks 10-35 (file 0x50-0x11F); accepted iff XOR32 checksum at RAM +0 matches XOR(words1..51)^0xABCD1234 AND sentinel BE value at RAM +0x44 equals 0x0228; otherwise FUN_0801ce40 calls FUN_0801d08c to rebuild blank blob and FUN_0801cd98 to rewrite it. No backup/mirror/generation counter found.

checksums.name: xor32_key_abcd1234
checksums.formula_detail: On block-reversed RAM image (reverse each 8-byte file block at 0x50-0x11F): stored u32le at blob +0x00 = XOR(u32le words at +0x04..+0xCF, words 1..51) XOR 0xABCD1234. Stored file bytes are 0x54-0x57 reversed within block. Reader FUN_0801ce40 and writer FUN_0801cd98 both compute this loop; key recovered from both samples (identical implied constant).

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 primitive: programs DMA3 src/dst/count|0x80000000 (0x040000D4 block), saves/restores IRQ enable, sets EEPROM timing from type descriptor, busy-waits DMA bit 0x8000. Used for both directions to/from 0x0D000000
EEPROM identify/type-select: arg 4 selects 4Kbit descriptor (descriptor+4=max blocks, +8=address bits); arg 0x40 and default select other descriptors

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: builds read-command bitstream (addr bits+3 via DMA), DMA-reads 0x44 halfwords from 0x0D000000, reassembles 4 u16 bit-by-bit into ptr+6 decrementing (origin of per-block byte reversal)
EEPROM write one 8-byte block: expands 4 u16 + address + start bits (addr bits+0x43 halfwords) via DMA to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM busy (0x0D000000 &1) with timer timeout
Verify one block: re-reads via FUN_08063388 and compares 4 i16 words, returns 0x8000 on mismatch
Write-and-verify: up to 3 attempts of FUN_08063438 then FUN_080635ac
SDK-style wrapper -> FUN_080632c0; called as func_0x0805c7ac(4) (identify EEPROM 4K). Edge recovered by decomp grep, absent from callgraph.json
SDK-style wrapper -> FUN_08063604(block,ptr); called per block in writer loop. Edge absent from callgraph.json
SDK-style wrapper -> FUN_08063388(block,ptr); called per block in reader loop. Edge absent from callgraph.json
High-level writer/flush: sync calls, FUN_0801c7f0 pack, XOR checksum store at blob+0, writes blocks 10..35 via FUN_0805c7c0 with FUN_0800ac34 between blocks, zeroes blob byte +0x35 in RAM afterwards

io_driver_functions.callers: none recovered (unrecovered indirect dispatch; boot/title hypothesis)
io_driver_functions.notes: High-level reader/load: reads blocks 10..35 via FUN_0805c7d4, forces blob +0x35=0, validates XOR checksum and sentinel 0x0228 at +0x44, on failure FUN_0801d08c + redundant second FUN_0801cd98, on success FUN_0801ca80 unpack
Pack: three 0x11C-byte records -> blob at stride 0x40 (4x24-bit fields, byte from +0x118, 2x12-byte MSB bit-packs, div-60 value via FUN_080637e8, 2x31-bit fields, sentinel per record at +0x44)
Unpack: exact inverse of FUN_0801c7f0, blob -> three 0x11C records (24-bit reassembly, bit expansion, *0x3C time rebuild)
Default init: memset 0x11C record and 208-byte blob, writes sentinel 0x0228 pairs at +0x44/+0x84/+0xC4, calls func_0x0805c7ac(4) identify EEPROM 4K
Blank reset: zeroes blob and three 0x11C records (FUN_0806570c memset), sets blob +4..+7=01 01 01 FF, calls FUN_0801cd98 to flush
Memset (byte replicated to u32) used to clear blob and records; listed as erase role only in that clearing use
